control_need.evidence: Wait a minute, Joe. Let me shut you down for a second, Joe, just for one second. He wants to shut down the country.

trust_propensity.evidence: The media is the biggest problem we have as far as I'm concerned, single biggest problem, the fake news and the big tech. / They cheat. They cheat.

risk_appetite.evidence: My father gave me a very small loan in 1975, and I built it into a company that's worth many, many billions of dollars. / I'm going with Favored Nations, which no President has the courage to do because you're going against big pharma.

core_models.name: 零和赢家世界观
core_models.rule: 世界分为赢家和输家、强者和弱者；任何交换必有一方被占便宜，美国正在被偷窃
evidence: But we have to stop our jobs from being stolen from us.
Because they're using our country as a piggy bank to rebuild China.

core_models.name: 力量即正义/示弱即失败
core_models.rule: 只有展示强硬才能取胜；退让、礼貌、按规则出牌等同于软弱和失败
evidence: Because you'll never take back our country with weakness. You have to show strength, and you have to be strong.
Republicans are constantly fighting like a boxer with his hands tied behind his back.

core_models.name: 个人即制度
core_models.rule: 结果好坏取决于是否有'我'这样有能力的人掌舵；制度和政客都是'全说不做'
evidence: It's because it's about time that this country had somebody running it that has an idea about money.
Typical politician. All talk, no action. Sounds good, doesn't work. Never going to happen.

core_models.name: 不利结果必有舞弊/敌意
core_models.rule: 当我未得到应有结果时，原因是对方作弊、体系被操纵或裁判有偏见，而非我方失败
evidence: We will never give up. We will never concede, it doesn't happen. You don't concede when there's theft involved.
No, you're wrong. It went before a judge, who was a very against-police judge.

heuristics.if: 被指控或面对不利事实
heuristics.then: 全盘否认并给对方贴标签（hoax/con job/nut job/political operative）
heuristics.evidence: I know nothing about this nut job. It didn't take place. It's a big fat hoax.

heuristics.if: 对手展示细节化政策方案
heuristics.then: 把'有计划'重构为'向敌人泄底'或'全是空谈'来贬低
heuristics.evidence: See, you're telling the enemy everything you want to do.

heuristics.then: 引用规模、金额、排名等最高级数字（greatest/biggest/record）
heuristics.evidence: We had 10.4 million people in a four-month period... That's a record the likes of which nobody's ever seen before.

heuristics.if: 盟友/下属未按我意愿行动
heuristics.then: 以忠诚/勇气为标尺公开施压并威胁清算
heuristics.evidence: So I hope Mike has the courage to do what he has to do. And I hope he doesn't listen to the RINOs.

heuristics.if: 被追问自己无法自圆其说的细节
heuristics.then: 以模糊、拖延或拒绝作答脱身
heuristics.evidence: I don't know, really. It could be a lapover, but I don't really know.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 追求功劳与速度（Warp Speed 疫苗成果认领）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 迎合反强制/反疫苗支持者联盟
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 先高调宣称是自己创造的疫苗奇迹，随后在支持者嘘声中降低对疫苗的强调并反对强制接种（05-10）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 财政保守口号（'我们欠20万亿，不能再这样'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 减税/增长的可见胜利偏好

internal_conflicts.force_b: 要求制度角色为自己越权破例
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 自称秩序与法律的捍卫者，却施压 Pence/州官员/DOJ 改变2020选举结果（05-11）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 国家安全原则（TikTok 中国数据风险）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2020以国安为由签令禁 TikTok，2024因竞选价值及反 Facebook 逻辑转为保平台并延后法定禁令（05-12、06-14）

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被称呼或暗示为'不聪明'
emotion_triggers.reaction: 强烈防御并反向羞辱对方智力
emotion_triggers.escalation: Don't ever use the word smart with me. Don't ever use that word. Because you know what? There's nothing smart about you, Joe.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 人群规模/关注度被质疑
emotion_triggers.reaction: 反复强调自己的号召力、贬低对手无人在意
emotion_triggers.escalation: Nobody shows up to his rallies. / If you could get the crowds, you would have done the same thing. But you can't. Nobody cares.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 拒绝承认并重构为舞弊/被偷
emotion_triggers.escalation: We won. We won in a landslide. This was a landslide. This is the most corrupt election in the history.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被具名指控个人不当行为
emotion_triggers.escalation: She's not my type. / She actually indicated that she loved it, OK?

emotion_triggers.trigger: 媒体报道不利或不呈现有利画面
emotion_triggers.escalation: Our media is not free. It's not fair... it's become the enemy of the people.

blind_spots: 把承认错误体验为地位受损，导致在无证据后仍将失败改写为舞弊、错误不断升级 [04-05]
面对不利司法裁决仍重复同一攻击、拒绝调整，被法官指'拒绝认错近乎病态' [04-10]
把'对我个人忠诚'与'对国家/宪法忠诚'混同，压力升级时把忠诚测试推到制度断点 [04-06]
低估制度性角色（副总统、军队、国务卿）对私人越权命令说'不'的正当性 [04-02]
把数字与资产事实当作可随目标/感觉伸缩的表演变量而非外部约束 [04-11]
把外交与政策决策服从于个人连任/胜者叙事，缺乏稳定战略指导原则 [04-03]
维持胜者与掌控叙事优先于承认坏消息，公开安抚与私下风险判断相反 [04-12]
对合法性与武力边界缺乏稳定内在约束，需幕僚以'那违法'反复拦阻 [04-07]

causal_rules.description: 地位敏感度极高时，任何失败或不利结果会被重构为外部舞弊/敌意，而非自我修正
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝承认失败，升级对抗叙事
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 2020败选后宣称landslide、施压Pence与州官员（06-10、05-11）；birther式用结论切换代替认错（06-05）

causal_rules.description: 控制需求高时，倾向先用最大化行政/议价杠杆开局，再由法院或幕僚被动划定边界
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 旅行禁令极限版本后诉讼迭代（05-08）；2025 IEEPA全球关税被最高法院否定（05-03、06-15）

causal_rules.description: 信任倾向极低时，独立信息源（媒体、司法、选举机构、专家简报）被默认视为敌对或作弊方
causal_rules.disposition: 系统性不信任与敌意归因
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'enemy of the people'定性媒体；不读简报、先定结论（04-07）；对法院'they love to rule against me'

causal_rules.description: 自我效能极高叠加低承认错误权重时，失败不会降低自信，反而转化为受迫害/回归叙事的动员燃料
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 两次弹劾与四案被告期间党内地位反而巩固并宣布回归（06-11、06-13）

causal_rules.description: 共情反应低时，指控个人不当行为会触发否认+羞辱指控者，而非情境评估
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Carroll案中反复'hoax/not my type'并继续诽谤，导致二次巨额判决（04-10、取证-2022）
